description:
I am an astronomy enthusiast and software developer focused on creating digital apps and platforms. Currently, I am exploring 3D world development and Generative AI solutions.

In this hackathon, I am building an interactive 3D world to playfully teach the history of rovers, probes, and equipment left on Mars since the 1960s.

This is a solo team project, so I am not looking for new members at the moment. Have a great event everyone!
